main.description: Public attestation that this DID has signed up for Holdfast. Written to the user's own repository. Serves as the app participation signal for backfill and discovery. Fixed record key 'self'.

handle.description: User's handle at time of sign-up, for display purposes. Not authoritative — DID is the persistent identity.

acceptedTermsAt.description: Datetime the user accepted the Holdfast terms of participation.
